_note: Values marked NEEDS_CONFIRMATION require team input before use in live campaigns.

phase_1_discovery.goal: Keyword discovery — which keywords Amazon associates with the product
phase_1_discovery.budget_note: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: suggested daily budget for auto campaigns
phase_1_discovery.duration_note: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: 7-10 days typical, using 10 as default
phase_1_discovery.output: Keyword list with impression, CTR, and search term data

phase_2_validation.goal: Bottom-line unit economics validation per keyword — actual CVR, ACoS, margin
phase_2_validation.campaign_type: manual (exact + phrase match from Phase 1 keywords)
phase_2_validation.budget_note: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: suggested daily budget for manual campaigns
phase_2_validation.duration_note: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: suggested duration for manual campaigns
phase_2_validation.output: Keyword-level CVR, ACoS, CPC, margin validation data

HIGH.description: Sufficient data across enough keywords for confident margin decisions

MEDIUM.description: Directional signal present but some keywords lack volume

data_quality_thresholds._note: NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: these thresholds are initial estimates

extension_rules.trigger: Data quality is LOW after phase completes

stopping_rules.note: Tests always run their configured duration. No early auto-stop.

gate_2_pass.keyword_level_margin: Net margin positive on >=3 keywords with sufficient volume
gate_2_pass.blended_acos: Blended ACoS <= breakeven ACoS from margin-calculator
gate_2_pass.data_quality: HIGH or MEDIUM (LOW requires extension or human override)

conservative.label: Conservative — Pure Discovery
conservative.goal: Pure keyword discovery at minimal spend

balanced.label: Balanced — Discovery + Validation
balanced.goal: Balanced data collection + early conversion signal

keyword_focused.label: Keyword-Focused — Validate Specific Keywords
keyword_focused.goal: Validate specific keyword economics fast, skip auto discovery

helium10_column_mapping._note: Maps Helium10 Cerebro CSV columns to internal KeywordSet fields

placement_defaults._note: Default placement adjustment percentages per scenario type
